summary: Adversarial check of 7 Oct 16 carousels: text over people, cut text, readability, same person in a row

slides.detail: The 4-line quote runs from y 60 to 460. The last line 'some now.' (x 40-550, y 400-460) is over the main student's raised left knee and shin: her knee tops out at about x 395-430, y 370. The 'n' and 'o' of 'now.' cover her shin at x 400-470. The credit 'Wang Zhenbai · White Deer Grotto (Tang)' (y 485-510, x 40-565) crosses the same shin at x 440-500, and '(Tang)' sits on the top edge of her black shorts at x 510-565. 'You're spending' ends at x 810, y 370, just clear of her right knee at x 800-830, y 415. It does not touch the watermark, and the text is large and readable. The main student is a woman in black doing an arm balance (first slide, so there is no previous slide to compare).
slides.better_spot: x 40-1040, y 30-345: the empty ceiling, window and plant band across the full width. Re-wrap to 3 wider lines at a smaller size (about 80px) with the credit underneath, all ending above y 350 so it stays clear of the raised knee at y 370.

slides.detail: The quote (y 55-150, x 40-1030) and the Thai credit (y 165-195) are on the dark corrugated ceiling. The handstander's feet start at about y 280, so the text is well clear. 'tomorrow.' ends at x 940, y 150, just above and to the left of the blurred foreground person at the right edge (from about x 850, y 160): no overlap. The Thai credit passes over a ceiling lamp at x 145-255 but stays legible. Nothing is cut off, and the right margin is about 50px. Different main student from slide 1: a silhouetted man in a handstand, not the woman in black.

The quote (x 220-1030, y 975-1060) and credit (y 1083-1105) sit on the wooden floor below the bottom edge of the mat. The squatting man's feet end at about y 880 and the teacher's front foot at about y 920, so the text starts roughly 50px below the nearest foot. The credit ends about 75px above the watermark (y 1182). Contrast is good on the dark floor. Different main student from slide 2: an older shirtless man in teal shorts, not the silhouetted handstander in a dark tank top.

Nothing covers the student. The quote sits on the floor at bottom left (x 40-300, y 910-1215), about 130px left of her forearm (x 430+) and 190px from her hand (x 350-470, y 1270+). The problem is the layout. The column is only about 260px wide, so a short quote breaks into 7 ragged lines: 'Still dancing / at 100, she / heard 'I / wish I / could.' Her / answer: do / it.' That leaves one-word lines and a lone 'it.' at the end, so it reads poorly at a glance on a phone. The block plus its 2-line credit runs down to y 1300, so 'it.', 'Eileen Kramer' and 'AFP, 2015' sit level with the watermark (y 1180-1265), crowding it from the left with only about 100px between them. Different main student from slide 3: a woman in a pink top, not the squatting man.
slides.better_spot: x 40-400, y 895-1165: the same floor area, with the column widened to the full space left of her forearm (forearm edge at about x 430). Re-wrap to 4-5 balanced lines and a one-line credit 'Eileen Kramer · AFP, 2015' ending by about y 1165, above the watermark.

slides.detail: The quote (x 712-1020, y 130-395) and credit (y 410-475) are on the window and palm-leaf area at top right. No face, hand or body is covered, and the crouching woman at right starts at y 545. The background is busy: the white credit crosses a bright window frame at about x 855-880, but the dark shadow keeps it legible at phone size. Nothing is cut off, and the right margin is about 60px. Different main student from slide 4: a young man in an assisted arm balance, not the woman in pink.

The quote (x 65-560, y 50-175) and credit (y 195-220) are on the bright, blurred window at top left. The student's back and green top begin at about x 660 at y 100 and about x 600 at y 210, so there is a 40-100px gap. The blurred woman at left starts at y 295, below the text. The background is bright, but the dark shadow keeps the pale-yellow text readable. Nothing is cut off. Different main student from slide 5: a woman with a back tattoo, not the young man.

The quote (x 725-1030, y 50-310) and credit (y 330-390) are on the bright window and wall at top right. The main student's head ends at about x 630, and the blurred background figure in black shorts ends at about x 695, so neither is covered. The weakest point is contrast: the background behind the white credit 'Sutrasthana 1.15' is very bright (average luminance about 225), so it relies entirely on its drop shadow. It is still legible at phone size. The column is narrow and ragged ('root of' sits on its own line) but acceptable. Different main student from slide 6: an older man in blue shorts, not the tattooed woman.

The quote (x 593-1040, y 760-1020) and credit (y 1040-1100) are on the wall, floor and towel area at right. The closest the text gets is 'Exercise' and 'walking,' near the student's hanging right forearm, which is at about x 540-565 at y 760-860: a gap of only about 30px, tight but not touching. His hand and feet (x 460-535, y 930-1035) are about 60px away. The credit ends about 80px above the watermark. Contrast is good. Different main student from slide 7: a young man in teal shorts, not the older man.

Nothing covers the students. The quote (x 772-1030, y 960-1220) is on the dark mat, clear of the boat-pose man (torso edge at about x 520) and of the blurred background handstander's hands (y 860-930). Only about 54px separates 'BANGKOK' (ends x 718) from 'can' (x 772) on the same baseline, so on a phone it reads like one run-on line and the watermark looks crowded. The narrow 260px column also gives 6 ragged lines. Different main student from slide 8: a man in patterned shorts doing a boat-type pose, not the young man in teal shorts.
